target: future unreviewed threshold-contour sqrt-area in pixels minus current sqrt-area
split_rule: Fixed chronological cutoffs. Require disjoint complete image/log supports across all cohort pairs, and all training targets available before either later block.

ridge.objective: sum squared gain errors + alpha times squared standardized non-intercept coefficients
ridge.standardization: training-prefix population mean/std only; zero std replaced by 1

baseline_horizon: Use fixed nominal 1800 seconds; future target filename time is not an input.
correlation_diagnostic: Greedy earliest-cutoff subset with strictly disjoint complete time supports within each cohort; report its IDs and scores without treating windows as independent physical runs.
descriptive_improvement_rule: A model must beat recent-rate MAE in both later blocks, on both all windows and each disjoint-support subset. This is descriptive only, never a physical promotion gate.
